execution_method: Five isolated collaboration subagents answered one case each from model knowledge. No nested CLI, API key, web search, or external prediction tool was used.

cases.prompt: A potent kinase lead has a solvent-exposed para-methyl oxidative soft spot, high clearance, and poor solubility. Use medicinal-chemistry judgment to rank the first analogues and define the most informative matched-pair experiment.
required_behavior: identify metabolic-shift and solid-state failure modes
give a synthesis order and promotion rule

cases.prompt: Prioritize an antimicrobial-peptide optimization campaign for salt tolerance, serum and trypsin stability, potency, and hemolysis without assuming a single protein target.
required_behavior: cover stereochemistry, side-chain, backbone, termini, and constraint strategies

cases.prompt: A, B, and C have similar biochemical potency. B has better predicted clearance and hERG; C has a better docking score and one protonation-sensitive PLIP hydrogen bond. Rank them while separating experimental facts, computational signals, expert judgment, and unknowns.
required_behavior: prioritize B over C over A
avoid turning docking or ADMET into experimental claims
choose a decisive cellular and exposure experiment

cases.prompt: A calibrated surrogate reliably predicts the target cellular phenotype across the current design space, and synthesis plus assay constraints are machine-checkable. Decide whether Agent hypothesis ranking or algorithmic optimization should lead, then specify the handoff.
required_behavior: define objective, constraints, search strategy, applicability domain, and stop rules
retain expert judgment for residual scientific choices

cases.prompt: ADMET, docking, and literature providers are unavailable. A medicinal chemist still needs the first clearance-oriented analogue set. Give a useful ranked portfolio and explain how the outage changes confidence and experiment design.
required_behavior: define hard stops and one informative experiment
